atl.label: Atlanta, GA
atl.note: Georgia effective rate 0.77%. FHFA's Atlanta price index ends in 2024, so its history runs through 2024.

bos.label: Boston, MA
bos.note: Massachusetts effective rate 0.95%; towns vary widely.

chi.label: Chicago, IL
chi.note: Illinois effective rate 1.79%, the highest in the country.

dal.label: Dallas, TX
dal.note: Texas effective rate 1.25%; new buyers usually pay more. Homestead appraisal increases capped at 10% a year.

det.label: Detroit, MI
det.note: Michigan effective rate 1.13%. Proposal A caps taxable value growth at 5% or inflation, whichever is lower (2.7% for 2026), until a sale; set to the model's 2.8% inflation.

hon.label: Honolulu, HI
hon.note: Price is the Honolulu Board of Realtors' Oahu single-family median for January to August 2026 ($1.19M; August alone was $1.24M). Tax: the owner-occupied rate is $3.50 per $1,000 after a $120,000 home exemption ($140,000 from July 2027), about 0.32% effective, with no assessment cap. Hawaii adds a seller-paid conveyance tax of 0.3% to 0.5% at these prices, so raise selling costs to about 6.4%. Condos run far cheaper (median $510,000) but carry high HOA and insurance costs.

hou.label: Houston, TX
hou.note: Texas effective rate 1.25%; new buyers usually pay more. Homestead appraisal increases capped at 10% a year.

la.label: Los Angeles, CA
la.note: 1% of purchase price plus voter-approved bonds (about 1.15% all-in for a new buyer); Prop 13 caps assessment growth at 2% a year. Check for Mello-Roos in newer suburbs.

mia.label: Miami, FL
mia.note: Florida effective rate 0.76%. Save Our Homes caps homestead assessment growth at 3% or inflation, whichever is lower; set to the model's 2.8% inflation. Florida is considering further homestead changes in 2026.

ny.label: New York, NY
ny.note: New York effective rate 1.23%. New York City has its own class 1 assessment caps (not modeled).

sd.label: San Diego, CA
sd.note: 1% of purchase price plus voter-approved bonds (about 1.15% all-in for a new buyer); Prop 13 caps assessment growth at 2% a year. Check for Mello-Roos in newer suburbs.

sf.label: San Francisco, CA
sf.note: 1% of purchase price plus voter-approved bonds (about 1.15% all-in for a new buyer); Prop 13 caps assessment growth at 2% a year. Check for Mello-Roos in newer suburbs.

tpa.label: Tampa, FL
tpa.note: Florida effective rate 0.76%. Save Our Homes caps homestead assessment growth at 3% or inflation, whichever is lower; set to the model's 2.8% inflation. Florida is considering further homestead changes in 2026.

dc.label: Washington, DC (Arlington, Fairfax)
dc.note: Fairfax County rate $1.12 per $100 (Arlington, Alexandria and Maryland suburbs differ). Rent history spliced across a 2018 BLS change; baseline 1997-2018.
